renderer.input: JSON only; strict shape/attributes/types/limits; optional stored format version must match
renderer.output: HTML generated only by fixed renderer templates and contextual escaping
renderer.invalid_document: valid=false and html empty; catalog shows review message and does not fall back to legacy HTML when a sidecar row exists

allowlist.image: root-relative or relative image/ path with restricted ASCII segments; no scheme/host/query/fragment/dot traversal
allowlist.button_url: HTTP(S) absolute URL without user/pass or single-root-relative path; rejects protocol-relative, javascript and data
allowlist.text: escaped with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5; newline becomes fixed br element
allowlist.columns: only 2 or 3 columns; CSS stacks on mobile

catalog_compatibility.row_valid: render server-side and pass trusted renderer HTML to template
catalog_compatibility.row_invalid_or_query_error: fail closed; no raw legacy HTML fallback for that row
catalog_compatibility.list_excerpt: continues using existing description HTML snapshot
